name: cashu/cashu-wallet-php
description: Single-file, zero-dependency PHP implementation of the Cashu protocol. Composer is used for dev tooling (tests) only; consumers should require CashuWallet.php directly.

suggest.ext-gmp: Preferred big-integer backend (much faster than bcmath)
suggest.ext-intl: Required for BIP-39 NFKD normalization of non-ASCII mnemonics and passphrases

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the full test suite (PHPUnit + legacy plain-PHP tests)
scripts-descriptions.test:legacy: Run the original plain-PHP storage safety test
